decisions.rationale: The executor reproduced a failure of a protected pre-existing general-harness unit test. The immutable executable contract limits write_serial text to 1..256 UTF-8 bytes and separately requires append_newline to be boolean; it does not redefine the limit as post-newline transport size. Preserving the protected compatibility contract outweighs the negligible risk of restoring the prior text-length predicate.
decisions.smallest_fix: Restore write_serial admission to a 1..256-byte limit on text itself while retaining exact boolean validation and every unrelated UART validation; correct only the new contradictory test expectation.
